prerequisites: Materials Science and Materials Technology, part 1 and 2
Applied Geometry and Engineering Graphics, part 1 and 2

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire main knowledge and practical skills for designing technological mouldings, produced by casting, plastic deformation and welding.
Acquire basic knowledge about precise measurement and technological specifications of constructions.
Acquire basic knowledge about design automation.
Acquire basic knowledge about course and diploma projects.
Acquire basic knowledge about the study for Master and PhD degrees and the engineering practice.

syllabus_topics: Technological capabilities of production methods of casting, plastic deformation and welding of discrete moulding and ready parts
Technological analysis of the material, form, sizes and preciseness of ready parts
Basic knowledge about the technological design of mouldings and welded products
Contemporary means of technological analysis and design of mouldings

assessment_methods.method: Defense of the course assignment (technological design of mouldings for given particular products and ways for their manufacturing)

assessment_rules: Continuous assessment is formed from the results of the tests and the defense of the course assignment.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
